To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed a framework, called SC-Share, that utilizes a stochastic performance model and a game-theoretic market model to achieve efficient resource sharing in a cost-induced, cooperative fashion, and that we have shown, empirically, that our proposed framework achieves efficient resource sharing decisions.
the framework is able to achieve efficient and profitable service, while meeting SLAs, for a variety of realistic settings.
the SC-Share market framework can achieve profitable resource sharing in small-scale clouds by converging to market equilibrium.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel framework for efficient resource sharing in the small cloud.
the development of a novel framework that enables resource sharing among autonomous small-scale clouds in a performance-driven manner, thereby enabling them to achieve profitable service.

the design and implementation of a market-based resource sharing framework that can be used to increase the performance of small clouds by sharing resources with other clouds, while maintaining customer satisfaction and profitability.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
SC-Share is a promising framework that can be used for resource sharing among SCs, thereby enabling them to increase their capacity and improve their performance.
our framework provides a practical and efficient solution for resource sharing in the small cloud.
our framework is able to achieve efficient sharing of cloud resources among SCs, while satisfying SLAs, and that the framework is scalable to a large number of SCs and resources.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed framework enables SCs to achieve profitable resource sharing, and thus, to provide better services to customers.
we propose and evaluate a framework that allows small-scale cloud service providers to efficiently cooperate in order to provide profitable service while meeting their customers’ SLAs.
SC-Share provides a practical, cost-efficient, and scalable approach for SCs to share their resources in a cooperative fashion, thereby achieving profitable service and maintaining customer SLAs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
SC-Share can be used to improve the profitability of SCs through cost-effective resource sharing, while maintaining customer service level agreements (i.e., performance).
the SC-Share model can be used as a basis for designing and operating a resource-sharing market for small clouds.
resource sharing markets can be used for the SCs to achieve profitable service with high performance, while satisfying their customers’ SLAs.
